Package arztis.econnector.ihe.model

Class HcpAssertion

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.model.HcpAssertion
public class HcpAssertion extends Object
This class includes fields of HCP (health care provider) assertion. It extracts information of received XML HCP assertion. Following elements and attributes of assertion are extracted:
element/attribute Path to element/attribute
notBefore /Conditions/@NotBefore
notOnOrAfter /Conditions/@NotOnOrAfter
issuer /Issuer
subject /Subject/NameID
claims key: /AttributeStatement/Attribute/@Name
value: /AttributeStatement/Attribute/AttributeValue

HCP assertions always have same structure.

  • Method Details

    • getIssuer

      public String getIssuer()
      URI that identifies endpoint of issuing service. For HCP assertion, it is the URI that representing ELGA ETS
      Returns:
      issuer

    • getSubject

      public String getSubject()
      Identifier of health care provider to whom HCP assertion was issued. Identifier contains values of GDA index. Identifier is formatted like ID^oidIssuingAuthority@description
      Returns:
      identifier of health care provider

    • getClaims

      public Map<String,Object> getClaims()
      Map filled with HCP identity attributes and permissions. Key is name of attribute and value is attribute value.
      Returns:
      HCP identity attributes and permissions

    • getNotBefore

      public Date getNotBefore()
      Time instant from which assertion can be used.
      Returns:
      time

    • getNotOnOrAfter

      public Date getNotOnOrAfter()
      Time instant at which assertion expires. This value is same value as in attribute "notBefore" plus 4 hours.
      Returns:
      time
